messages:
Alex M.: Quick heads-up — we're onboarding fjord-8b v1.0 for evals. License snippet on HF page looks like: 'NonCommercial + Attribution required + No redistribution of model weights or binaries'. cc @CJ (Legal). https://models.example/fjord/v1/LICENSE
Maria (ML): Can we run quant experiments and share quantized weights internally? Need to know if 'no redistribution' blocks internal qweight artifacts moving to Dedicated tenants.
CJ (Legal): Need full text but that wording usually forbids distribution outside org. Internal experimentation OK if artifacts never leave our infra. Can't let customers download weights.
legal-bot: Automated scan result: license detected = "NonCommercial-Attribution-NoRedistribute v0.9". Flags: EXPORT_PROHIBITED, COMMERCIAL_LIMITS. See /legal-scans/3472001111.
Sana (ML Eng): On quant side: 4-bit qconfig (GPTQ-like) yields ~2.4% LM degradation on our conv benchmark but 1.1% on chat evals. If we keep qweights inside runtime (no customer access) we still get better throughput.
Jordan (Product): Enterprise customers ask for on-prem or dedicated snapshots. If license forbids redistribution we can't provide downloadable images. Is hosting inference (hosted + Dedicated serving) allowed?
CJ (Legal): Hosting/serving is usually allowed unless license says 'no commercial use' — but it says NonCommercial so commercial hosting is an issue. We need commercial permission or to restrict to research-only. Two options: 1) Request commercial license from model owner. 2) Offer research-only hosting (no paid prod use).
Alex M.: For Dedicated we need clear custody rules: serve-only mode (no weight export), audit logs, and a UI attribution banner linking to the model license. Can we enforce that at runtime?
Sana (ML Eng): Yes, we can enforce via runtime policy. Proposed policy snippet: 
```
# serve_policy.yaml
allow_weight_export: false
require_attribution_banner: true
attribution_text: "Model: fjord-8b v1.0 — see https://models.example/fjord/v1/LICENSE"
quantization_allowed: internal-only
embeddings_storage: hosted-only
```
Alex M.: Also need to tag the model in catalog metadata so Console shows the license and a tooltip during route creation.
Maria (ML): One more nuance — embeddings: license doesn't explicitly mention embeddings. But some legal teams treat embeddings as derivative outputs. CJ?
CJ (Legal): Embeddings are gray. If license restricts commercial use of the model, deriving embeddings for commercial products is risky. Recommend we: a) classify as Research-only; or b) get explicit written permission for embeddings + hosting.
Jordan (Product): Impact to roadmap: if Research-only, mark in Console and block creation of paid routes. If owner grants permission we can enable a gated commercial route with extra audit headers.
ops-bot: Preflight check: infrastructure flags — weight-export toggle currently default=true for new models. Failing: set allow_weight_export=false for fjord-8b v1.
Sana (ML Eng): I'll run the quant eval suite and produce a short eval report (perplexity, avg latency, token cost, regression diffs) and attach it to the onboarding ticket. Will also surface prompt regressions against our safety set.
Alex M.: Action items: @CJ — confirm whether NonCommercial prohibits paid hosted inference (ask model owner for license clarification). @Sana — run quant evals and produce report (include example prompts that regress). @Maria — update model-catalog entry to include license text and set weight-export=false. @Jordan — decide UI gating language for Console.
CJ (Legal): I'll ping the model owner and ask for a commercial license/clarification. If they refuse, we mark as RESEARCH_ONLY and proceed with internal evals only.
Maria (ML): Noted. I'll block route creation for paid tiers until we have CJ sign-off.
Alex M.: Thanks — will keep thread updated after Sana's evals and CJ's reply. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Ticket created: ONB-1227 (fjord-8b v1.0) — policy flag required: allow_weight_export=false.
